details: Bulwark construction. Low olive-green carrier, two huge flanking elongated horizontally-mounted tapered silos with buff front collars, sloping central armored olive cockpit bridge beneath and between the pods, one short amber visor below a buff roof, two widely splayed reverse-jointed legs with visible rearward hocks and broad short dark contact pads. Exactly one pod on each side, on close-coupled armored cheek trunnions. Each nose has four substantial guided cells arranged 2 across and 2 high. Keep a squat, broad front view and substantial fore-aft depth in both pods. No arms, hands or extra weapons.
